greet.speaker: sera
greet.text: You're the Weavers running the Beacon. I've watched three crews go down that hole. You're the first that came back with the same faces.

choices.text: We're short a shield. You look like one.
[Undercity] I know that Ashfound patch. You purged the Ninth Stair.
[Vault] You've got bunker shoulders. Who sealed you in?

why.speaker: sera
why.text: I was Ashfound. Purge detail. There's a village on the Undercity's third depth that I burned on orders, and the orders were wrong. I want to see what's left of it. Take me down there and I'll hold your line for as long as you need.

choices.text: Come with us. We'll find your village.
Why should we trust an Ashfound torch?
We don't carry guilt for other people.

trust.speaker: sera
trust.text: You shouldn't. Trust the shield, not the woman. The shield hasn't lied yet.

refused.speaker: sera
refused.text: Changed your mind, or just short a shield again?

recruited.speaker: sera
recruited.text: Say the word and we go down.

holding.speaker: sera
holding.text: Same as the plating. Dented. Serviceable.

opened.speaker: sera
opened.text: No. It isn't. Ask me again after the village.
